statuses.sourced: From a named standard, datasheet or format (the source is as the code cites it; not re-checked)
statuses.estimated: Read off a drawing's scale or a stated rough estimate: the source does not state it outright
statuses.design_default: The engine's own choice, which the code says is a default, a design value or a guess
statuses.example: An illustrative figure, not claimed right for any real part
statuses.unstated: No basis is stated in the code
